answer: A hostile operator running 146 aliases as a result needs 118 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in terrace, expire in comet, and tundra lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 29 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
